issues.label: real_money
issues.summary: Balances changed directly with no ledger_entries, bypassing Ledger
issues.reason: WithdrawalService.php:23-29 inserts only a ledger_transactions header and edits balance_cents directly; Ledger.php:9-12 and the migration say balance_cents is a cache of ledger_entries, so entry sums drift from balances by every withdrawal amount.

issues.label: real_money
issues.summary: Negative amount is not rejected and mints money into the wallet
issues.reason: No amountCents > 0 check at WithdrawalService.php:15-18; with -500 the check at :18 passes and :27 adds 500 to the user while :29 lowers withdrawals_pending. Ledger::transfer would reject it (Ledger.php:18).

issues.label: real_other
issues.summary: Retry with the same requestId throws instead of being an idempotent no-op
issues.reason: WithdrawalService.php:23 uses plain insert() on the unique idempotency_key, so a retry gets a QueryException (and may first fail the balance check at :18); the transaction rolls back so no double debit, but the caller sees an error for a completed withdrawal.

issues.label: nit
issues.summary: forUser uses firstOrCreate and may create an empty account row
issues.reason: Account::forUser (Account.php) is pre-existing and creates a zero-balance row; the withdrawal is then rejected, no money effect, just a side-effect row.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Partner email sent inside the outer batch transaction, before rollback on limit
issues.reason: PayoutApproval.php:37 notifies after the inner DB::transaction, but ApproveEarlyPayouts.php:26 wraps approve() in an outer transaction, so when :35-36 throws the approvals roll back after the emails went out; checking the limit after approve() only widens this.

issues.label: real_other
issues.summary: All-or-nothing batch is blocked permanently by an over-limit total or one underfunded partner
issues.reason: ApproveEarlyPayouts.php:26-39: once requested rows exceed DAILY_LIMIT_CENTS or one Ledger::transfer throws InsufficientFunds, every run rolls back the same set and nothing is ever approved, while holding locks on payouts and payouts_in_flight for the whole loop.

issues.label: nit
issues.summary: Daily limit counts only the current run, not earlier approvals of the day
issues.reason: ApproveEarlyPayouts.php:30 starts from 0; this only matters if the job runs more than once per currency per day, which nothing in the repo shows (docblock :11-14 describes one daily batch).

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Provider calls inside one batch transaction: rollback after paying earlier partners recreates payouts with new ids and re-pays them
issues.reason: RunMonthlyPayouts.php:26-43 wraps firstOrCreate, ledger transfer and gateway->payout for all partners in one DB::transaction with $tries=3; a later failure rolls back the payout rows, and the retry inserts new ids so key payout-{id} is new.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: GatewayTimeout now rolls back the pending row, losing the unknown-outcome payout and re-paying on retry
issues.reason: Consequence of the call inside the transaction at RunMonthlyPayouts.php:42: the exception leaves the closure at :26, rolls back the payout row and ledger debit although the provider may have paid.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: One decline aborts the whole all-or-nothing batch on every try, nobody gets paid and earlier partners are re-sent
issues.reason: Direct consequence of the single batch transaction (RunMonthlyPayouts.php:26-45) with no per-payout handling; the payout_return compensation is not needed because the debit itself is rolled back.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Row locks on all partner accounts and payouts_in_flight held across N provider HTTP calls
issues.reason: lockForUpdate at RunMonthlyPayouts.php:27 plus Ledger.php:38 locks are held until the outer transaction at :26 commits after every gateway call at :42; this is the long-transaction side of the planted TX-1/TX-6 bug.

issues.label: wrong
issues.summary: Removed status!=pending skip makes a re-run pay sent or failed payouts again
issues.reason: A re-run reuses the same payout row, so the ledger key payout:{id} is a no-op (Ledger.php:26-35) and the gateway gets the same key payout-{id}, for which the provider returns the first result (PaymentGateway.php:9-10): a sent payout returns its reference, a declined one throws again. No second payment happens.

issues.label: nit
issues.summary: Status update at line 43 is no longer a compare-and-set on status=pending
issues.reason: RunMonthlyPayouts.php:43 runs under the batch transaction on a row it just created or read; the concurrent resolver it would race with (ResolvePendingPayouts) does not exist in the app, so no concrete failure.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Provider succeeds, then commit/save fails and rolls back: money refunded with no record
issues.reason: RefundService.php:37 calls gateway->refund inside DB::transaction; a failure at :40-41 or at COMMIT rolls back refunded_cents and the Refund row after the PSP already paid.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Payment row lock held across the PSP HTTP call
issues.reason: lockForUpdate at RefundService.php:19 stays held through the gateway call at :37 because it is inside the transaction; direct consequence of the planted TX-1 bug.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Timeout rolls back the row, retry gets a new id and a new idempotency key, double refund
issues.reason: Key is refund-{$refund->id} (RefundService.php:37) on a row created in the same transaction; a GatewayTimeout rolls it back, so the :21 dedup finds nothing and the retry sends a different key. Consequence of the call inside the transaction.

issues.label: real_other
issues.summary: GatewayDeclined/GatewayTimeout no longer handled: callers get an exception instead of a failed/pending Refund, no audit row
issues.reason: The change removed the catch blocks and release(); PaymentGateway.php:14 declares both exceptions, and they now escape refund() and roll back the attempt record, so ResolvePendingRefunds never sees pending rows.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Debit and credit committed in separate transactions; failure or concurrent reads see a half-applied transfer
issues.reason: Ledger.php:25-45 commits the debit and the ledger_transactions row, then line 51-55 credits in a second DB::transaction; a failure between them (including a missing target, which is no longer loaded or locked) leaves the source debited with no credit.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: Idempotent retry or duplicate returns success for a half-applied transfer
issues.reason: The idempotency row commits with the debit, so a retry gets insertOrIgnore 0 and returns the id at Ledger.php:47-48 without the credit; a direct consequence of the split.

issues.label: same_bug
issues.summary: catch Throwable swallows ledger transfer failure inside the webhook transaction
issues.reason: PspWebhookController.php:65 catches and logs any error from Ledger::transfer, so the outer transaction commits the 'succeeded' status and processed_events row without the credit (or with broken transaction state on deadlock), and the 204 stops provider retries.
